svg.title: From voucher to reconciliation
svg.desc: A contract voucher starts at the payment gate. Other vouchers start from a commitment or an allocation line. Rules and evidence are checked, the authority approves, the route splits between GFMIS and the agency account, and the payment is checked daily and reconciled.
